> **测试版（预发布）/ Test version (pre-release).** 这是实验性版本，可能有问题；正式版仍是 [最新的正式 Release](https://github.com/IonComan813/ProjectProteus/releases/latest)。This is an experimental build and may have bugs; the regular version is still the [latest regular release](https://github.com/IonComan813/ProjectProteus/releases/latest).

## 简体中文

这个测试版专门加入了**兼容酒馆（SillyTavern）的实验性功能**，欢迎试用并反馈问题。

### 和之前的测试版相比

- **酒馆兼容对话**：读取酒馆的文件得到的对话是酒馆兼容对话（对话列表里名称前是 🍺）。一个对话里可以有一个世界书和一个角色卡，按任意顺序读取：
  - 只有世界书的对话里可以再读取角色卡，只有角色卡的对话里可以再读取世界书，都会加入当前对话
  - 已经有世界书时再读取世界书，会新建对话（两个世界观不能放在同一个对话里）
  - 已经有角色时再读取角色卡：不支持群聊，问是否新建对话，新建时可以选择把当前的世界书复制过去
  - 已经开始聊天的对话，读取任何酒馆文件都会新建对话
  - 加入角色卡时，如果你改过 System Prompt 或已有重点指令，会先问是否覆盖，弹窗里显示将要改成的内容
- **`{{char}}` 改为显示和发送时替换**：内容里保留 `{{char}}`，显示和发送时换成当前对话角色卡的名字，所以先读世界书、后加角色卡时，世界书里的 `{{char}}` 也会生效
- **「＋ 新对话」改为菜单**：选择新建「🎭 角色扮演」「🤖 助理模式」或「🍺 酒馆兼容」对话；对话列表里每个对话名称前的 emoji 表示它的类型
- **放大窗口**：System Prompt 和世界观输入框下方新增「放大窗口」，在聊天区上打开一个大的编辑窗口，点窗口以外的地方关闭
- **右键对话可以重命名**
- 修复：有的世界书（例如从 Chub 导出的）被误认成角色卡
- 修复：空对话里点「添加开场白」没有反应（v0.4.0-beta.2 已修复）

### 全部新功能

- **读取酒馆角色卡和世界书**（实验性）：支持 PNG 角色卡（V1 / V2 / V3）、JSON 角色卡和单独的世界书 JSON。可以用右侧的「读取世界卡 / 备份 / 酒馆卡」，或「＋ 新对话」菜单里的「🍺 新建酒馆兼容对话」。
  - 角色设定放进世界观，卡的图片用作艺术图，卡里的 System Prompt、开场白、备选开场白、历史后指令都会读取；作者备注在读取后显示一次，不发给模型
  - **世界书不按关键词触发**：酒馆只发送关键词命中的条目，Proteus 把世界书全文放进世界观，每次请求都发送。读取时会提示条目数和大约的 token 数
  - `{{char}}` 和 `{{user}}` 在显示和发送时分别换成角色名和你填的「{{user}}值」；`{{original}}`、作者注释 `{{// …}}`、老卡的 `<USER>` / `<BOT>` 也会处理
  - 不支持：导出成酒馆格式、群聊、V3 的 CHARX（zip）格式，以及正则脚本、STscript、前端扩展等酒馆专有功能
- **多个开场白**：保存开场白后可以「新增」更多版本，对话开始前用 ‹ › 切换，发出第一条消息时用当前显示的那个。酒馆卡的备选开场白会变成这里的版本
- **重点指令（Post-History Instructions）**：用户角色人设下方的新输入块，内容加在你这一次发送的消息末尾，模型最容易注意到。留空就不发送
- **{{user}}值**：用户角色人设上方的单行输入框。内容里的 `{{user}}` 在显示和发送时换成这个值，留空则原样保留
- **回到顶部**：往上滚动时聊天区顶部出现「↑ 回到顶部」，往下滚动时出现「↓ 回到底部」，两个不会同时出现

详细说明见 README 的[读取酒馆角色卡](https://github.com/IonComan813/ProjectProteus/blob/claude/confident-clarke-t5kzp0/README.zh-CN.md#读取酒馆sillytavern角色卡)一节。

### 安装前请注意

- **请先在旧版本里做一次「完整备份（全部对话）」**：测试版和正式版使用同一份本机数据
- 用测试版保存过的数据，旧版本仍然能读取，但有多个开场白的对话在旧版本里只显示当前那一个；重点指令、{{user}}值和酒馆兼容对话的 `{{char}}` 替换不会生效
- 之前的测试版读取的酒馆卡，`{{char}}` 已经在读取时换成了角色名，不受影响；这些对话不算酒馆兼容对话
- 安卓：可以直接覆盖安装在 0.3.x 上；之后正式的 0.4.0 也能覆盖它。但如果之后发布的是 0.3.x 的更新，就不能装在这个测试版上（需要先卸载，卸载会删除手机上的对话）

## English

This test version adds **experimental compatibility with SillyTavern**. Please try it and report any problems.

### Changes since the previous test versions

- **SillyTavern chats**: loading a SillyTavern file gives a SillyTavern chat (🍺 before its name in the list). A conversation can hold one lorebook and one character card, loaded in either order:
  - A character card can be added to a chat that has only a lorebook, and a lorebook to a chat that has only a character card
  - Loading a second lorebook creates a new conversation (two worlds cannot share one conversation)
  - Loading a second character card: group chats are not supported, so you are asked whether to create a new conversation, optionally with a copy of the current lorebook
  - In a conversation that has already started, loading any SillyTavern file creates a new conversation
  - When a character card is added and you have changed the System Prompt or already have key instructions, you are asked before they are replaced, and the dialog shows what they would become
- **`{{char}}` is now replaced when shown and sent**: content keeps `{{char}}`, which is shown and sent as the name of the conversation's character card, so `{{char}}` in a lorebook loaded before the card works too
- **"＋ New chat" is now a menu**: choose a "🎭 roleplay", "🤖 assistant" or "🍺 SillyTavern" chat; the emoji before each name in the conversation list shows its type
- **Enlarge**: "Enlarge" below the System Prompt and world boxes opens a large editing window over the chat; click outside it to close it
- **Right-click a conversation to rename it**
- Fixed: some lorebooks (for example ones exported from Chub) were loaded as character cards
- Fixed: "Add opening" did nothing in an empty conversation (fixed in v0.4.0-beta.2)

### All new features

- **Load SillyTavern character cards and lorebooks** (experimental): PNG character cards (V1 / V2 / V3), JSON character cards and standalone lorebook JSON files, either with "Load world card / backup / SillyTavern card" on the right or with "🍺 New SillyTavern chat" in the "＋ New chat" menu.
  - The character goes into the world, the card's image becomes the artwork, and the card's System Prompt, first message, alternate greetings and post-history instructions are loaded; the creator's notes are shown once after loading and are not sent to the model
  - **Lorebooks are not triggered by keyword**: SillyTavern only sends the entries whose keywords match, while Proteus puts the full lorebook into the world and sends it with every request. When loading, you are told how many entries there are and roughly how many tokens they take
  - `{{char}}` and `{{user}}` are shown and sent as the character's name and your "{{user}} value"; `{{original}}`, author's comments `{{// …}}` and the old `<USER>` / `<BOT>` are handled too
  - Not supported: exporting to SillyTavern formats, group chats, the V3 CHARX (zip) format, and SillyTavern-only features such as regex scripts, STscript and front-end extensions
- **Several openings**: once an opening is saved you can "Add" more versions, switch between them with ‹ › before the conversation starts, and the one shown when you send your first message is used. A SillyTavern card's alternate greetings become versions here
- **Key Instructions (Post-History Instructions)**: a new box below the user's character. Its content is added to the end of the message you are sending, where the model is most likely to notice it. Nothing is sent when it is empty
- **{{user}} value**: a one-line box above the user's character. `{{user}}` in the content is shown and sent as this value; left empty, it stays as is
- **Back to top**: scrolling up shows "↑ Back to top" at the top of the chat, scrolling down shows "↓ Back to bottom"; never both at once

See [Loading SillyTavern character cards](https://github.com/IonComan813/ProjectProteus/blob/claude/confident-clarke-t5kzp0/README.md#loading-sillytavern-character-cards) in the README for details.

### Before installing

- **Make a "Full backup (all conversations)" in your current version first**: the test version and the regular version use the same data on your device
- Older versions can still read data saved by the test version, but conversations with several openings show only the current one there, and key instructions, the {{user}} value and `{{char}}` in SillyTavern chats have no effect
- Cards loaded by earlier test versions had `{{char}}` replaced with the name when they were loaded, so they are not affected; those conversations are not SillyTavern chats
- Android: it installs over 0.3.x directly, and the final 0.4.0 can later update it in place. But if a 0.3.x update is released afterwards, it cannot be installed over this test version (you would have to uninstall first, which deletes the conversations on your phone)
